bias.zh: 看空 · 重回 $1,550 上方，仍低于 200 日均线

read.en: ASML rose 1.7% on Nov 3 to $1,552.14, trading between $1,547.01 and $1,575.58. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,596.6) and 10-day ($1,601.8), the rising 200-day ($1,599.2) and the falling 30-day ($1,702.2) and 100-day ($1,737.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,666.01), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 11月3日上涨 1.7%，收于 $1,552.14，盘中区间 $1,547.01–1,575.58。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,596.6）和 10 日均线（$1,601.8）、上行的 200 日均线（$1,599.2）以及下行的 30 日（$1,702.2）和 100 日均线（$1,737.3）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,666.01），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $1,530.6–1,550 zone (Jul 29, Oct 30 and Oct 23 lows); the high of $1,575.6 stopped under the Oct 23 high of $1,581.6. Resistance is $1,575.6–1,581.6, then $1,596.6–1,601.8 (5, 200 and 10-day, Nov 2 high) and $1,666–1,690 (SAR, Oct 29 high). Support is $1,530.6–1,550, then $1,518 (Nov 2 low) and $1,493.5. A close above $1,582 would target $1,597–1,602; below $1,530, $1,518.

s.en: Jul 29 low $1,530.6; Oct 30 low $1,535.3; Oct 23 low $1,550, reclaimed
